column1: # What the differential test compares, and where each file came from.
# Columns: role, source (commit:path, or the path in this repo), sha256 of the bytes.
# v0.3.1 (86d99c1) is the newest published release and the dev pre-release is a4de67a; their
# src/config.cpp is the same file, and their core pins (c480d8a, f92be69) hold the same bytes for
# every core source that reader compiles. Comparison 1 is not empty by construction: the frozen
# reader is ecb14e4's src/config.cpp, which differs from v0.3.1's (e3f6d3f).
# Inputs under data/, each checked against its source by hash. A seed is the launcher-manifest.json
# seed at that commit, decoded from content_b64. dev is the rolling pre-release, whose target is
# a4de67a (gh release view dev); the dev tag points at 74431db, which is not that build.
# A first-run file is what Config::CreateDefaultConfig at that commit writes: the function and its
# DEFAULT_ constants cut from src/config.cpp and compiled alone (MSVC, Win32, Release, core headers
# from oracle/core-c480d8a). The test also checks that fnv_config_oracle writes the v0.3.1 file
# The predecessor's first-run files are Config::CreateDefaultConfig at each tag, cut from src/config.cpp
# the same way (its src/config.cpp is one file at v1.0.1 and v1.0.3; no core header is needed); both
# hold InputBlockMode=3 where the shipped file holds 0.
